correctness.rationale: The norm squared is max(Q1,Q2), Q1=(1+lambda)z1²+z2² and Q2=z1²+(1+lambda)z2². For all unit x,y and t>0, compare all four branch sums: same-index <=2(1+t²), mixed <=2(1+t²)+4lambda t/(lambda+2) using Euclidean diagonal sphere bound and Cauchy–Schwarz. Quadratic mean dominates p-power mean for 1<=p<=2; opposite diagonal unit vectors make both active mixed branches and both output norms equal, attaining the profile. Strict mixed-branch equality forces exactly the indicated signed-coordinate orbit even when p=2; lambda=0 and t=0 excluded.
residual_risks: No proof for higher-dimensional quadratic Lorentz spaces.
